chunks.title: DevAgent Remote

chunks.title: DevAgent Remote

Every task git-checkpointed, so any result can be reverted from the phone. 3 CLI agents behind one adapter interface; 13-message JSON protocol. 4,508 lines across 31 files in 10 days. chunks.title: Know what you keep, before you sell
chunks.text: Upstox: Know what you keep, before you sell. A decision layer on top of Upstox’s existing reports: tax if you sold today, what waiting saves, and how much of a gain survives charges. Comes with a working demo you can poke at.
chunks.group: Know what you keep, before you sell

chunks.title: Know what you keep, before you sell: Reports tell you what happened. Nobody tells you what to do.
chunks.text: Upstox. Reports tell you what happened. Nobody tells you what to do.. Upstox’s Ledger, P&L, Tax and Holdings reports are all records of the past, built to be read at ITR time. None of them answers what an investor asks right before clicking sell: what this costs in tax today, what waiting would change, how much of the INR 1.25L tax-free limit is going to waste, and how much of the gain survives charges.
chunks.group: Know what you keep, before you sell

chunks.title: Know what you keep, before you sell: Who already does what
chunks.text: Upstox. Who already does what. I lined up Upstox, Zerodha and Groww feature by feature and made one decision early: do not rebuild Upstox’s tax-loss harvesting. Losses hand off to that tool. The new layer is everything it skips: gain harvesting, the days left until a holding turns long-term (with the rupee value of waiting), what you keep after tax and charges, SIP lot clocks and an ELSS unlock tracker.
chunks.group: Know what you keep, before you sell

chunks.title: Know what you keep, before you sell: The rule I refused to break
chunks.text: Upstox. The rule I refused to break. The product defaults to “just looking”. It states tax consequences and never manufactures trading intent, because a tool that nudges people to trade is a different tool. The copy rules are enforced by tests, so the guardrail survives the next person who edits a string.
chunks.group: Know what you keep, before you sell

chunks.title: Know what you keep, before you sell: The engine underneath
chunks.text: Upstox. The engine underneath. A pure TypeScript tax engine implementing 25 rules, 6 personas that each prove a different rule, serverless routes on Upstox’s public APIs, and 158 tests. The tax logic never touches the network, which is why those tests stay boring.
chunks.group: Know what you keep, before you sell

chunks.title: Half the users, 25% more revenue

chunks.title: Half the users, 25% more revenue: Numbers that should not coexist
chunks.text: Upstox. Numbers that should not coexist. NSE active clients fell from 5.2M to 2.25M (14.5% to 5.6% share) while revenue rose 25% to INR 1,311 Cr. I tested 6 hypotheses and left 2 root causes standing as Groww climbed from 10.7% to 23.4%.

chunks.title: Half the users, 25% more revenue: Where the whitespace is
chunks.text: Upstox. Where the whitespace is. SEBI’s derivatives study found 93% of traders losing a combined INR 1.81 lakh Cr. The unsolved shift from trader to investor is the segment worth owning.

chunks.title: Half the users, 25% more revenue: What I would ship
chunks.text: Upstox. What I would ship. A 9-page spec repositioning the app as a self-directed investor platform: prioritised requirements, success metrics with 6- and 12-month targets, and a 5-phase launch gated on ship criteria.

chunks.title: Mall scales, Valmo predicts
chunks.text: Meesho: Mall scales, Valmo predicts. Where a 145 bps contribution-margin hit came from, and a two-layer system for scaling Meesho Mall without rebuilding the core experience.

chunks.title: Mall scales, Valmo predicts: One exit, one very expensive month
chunks.text: Meesho. One exit, one very expensive month. A 145 bps contribution-margin compression in FY26 traces back to a single 3PL exit (Ecom Express) that forced emergency capacity scaling on Valmo. Estimated avoidable cost: Rs 224–310 Cr, and a repeat at FY27 scale would cost about Rs 780 Cr.

chunks.title: Mall scales, Valmo predicts: Where my first model was wrong
chunks.text: Meesho. Where my first model was wrong. The first model assumed an ad-valorem take rate (t = 0.19). Reconciling revenue to a roughly Rs 59 per order fixed fee falsified it, so the contribution equation became CP = f + a·AOV − F − R.

chunks.title: Mall scales, Valmo predicts: The fix, in two layers
chunks.text: Meesho. The fix, in two layers. Two layers: contextual Mall discovery from high-intent search, and a lane-level capacity-intelligence layer on Valmo. It scales existing Meesho Mall (+93% NMV YoY, 1,200+ brands) without rebuilding the core experience.

chunks.title: Mall scales, Valmo predicts: How I would prove it
chunks.text: Meesho. How I would prove it. A user-level A/B test with contribution margin per shipped order as the primary metric, 5 guardrails, and a 4-stage rollout from a 3-city pilot to GA across 50 Tier-2 cities.
